entries.scope: Undici 6.29.0 bundled inside npm 12.2.1, used only by release tooling and never shipped with the Home Assistant integration
entries.reason: Owner-approved temporary acceptance of GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c on 2026-10-24, extended after the owner's delegated risk decision on 2026-10-29 to GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx and GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm. npm 12.2.1 still bundles undici 6.29.0 inside the unused npm-publishing dependency of the release tools; project overrides cannot replace that bundled copy, and a compatible downgrade introduced additional high-severity findings. Only these advisory IDs at this exact path are accepted through the unchanged expiry; other advisories and paths remain blocking
